No sand, beige, clay, simplified flat cartoon or outline-only figures. Equipment black/grey. Do not invent product features, extra labels, exercise facts or decorative elements.

IMPORTANT REBRAND: the masters still show the OLD Lightweight logo. REMOVE that entire old wordmark and dinosaur from the generated image. Do NOT reproduce or redraw ANY logo, brand name or symbol. The owner's NEW authentic transparent Harda logo PNG will be pasted as a separate original layer at x48,y19,218×71 px after generation. Keep every other object/text below y110.
